STS2_BALANCEMOD_SORCERY_STRIKE.title: Sorcery Strike
STS2_BALANCEMOD_SORCERY_STRIKE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw 1 card.
Apply 1 [gold]Sorcery Vulnerable[/gold].
STS2_BALANCEMOD_SORCERY_DEFEND.title: Sorcery Defend
STS2_BALANCEMOD_DEATH_REAP.title: Death Reap
STS2_BALANCEMOD_DEATH_REAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Heal HP equal to [gold]unblocked damage[/gold].
STS2_BALANCEMOD_POWER_THOUGHT.title: Power Through
STS2_BALANCEMOD_CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate
STS2_BALANCEMOD_ELECTRODYNAMICS.title: Electrodynamics
STS2_BALANCEMOD_JAX.title: J.A.X.
STS2_BALANCEMOD_NECRONOMICURSE.title: Necronomicurse
STS2_BALANCEMOD_NECRONOMICURSE.descripti: There is no escape from this [red]Curse[/red].
STS2_BALANCEMOD_STEP_BY_STEP.title: Step by Step
STS2_BALANCEMOD_STEP_BY_STEP.description: Spend {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} Energy. For the next {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} turns, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your turn.
STS2_BALANCEMOD_SPARRING.title: Sparring
STS2_BALANCEMOD_SPARRING.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The side that deals less damage heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
STS2_BALANCEMOD_RAM.title: Ram
STS2_BALANCEMOD_RAM.description: If [gold]Osty[/gold] has at least {HpLoss:diff()} HP, make it lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP and deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
DRAIN_POWER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Upgrade {IfUpgraded:show:all|{Cards:diff()} random} cards in your discard pile.
STS2_BALANCEMOD_EVOLVE.title: Evolve
STS2_BALANCEMOD_EVOLVE.description: Whenever you draw a Status card, draw {EvolvePower:diff()} {EvolvePower:plural:card|cards}.
GRAND_FINALE.description:
Can only be played if the number of cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] is less than or equal to X.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Spend {CalculatedSpend:energyIcons()})|{IfUpgraded:show:
Spend {EnergySaved:energyIcons()} less when played.|}}
WELL_LAID_PLANS.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
STS2_BALANCEMOD_EVISCERATE.title: Eviscerate
STS2_BALANCEMOD_EVISCERATE.description:
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each card discarded this turn.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 3 times.
COOLANT.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Power[/gold] card, draw {CoolantPower:diff()} {CoolantPower:plural:card|cards}.
